title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
question: Is Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion an original anime or an adaptation?
answer_text: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion is an original anime. The source material details a campaign of conquest by the Holy Empire of Britannia, with Lelouch as an exiled prince using a power to undermine the empire from within. This establishes the core premise of the series.
